svg.title: SEED workflow
svg.desc: Follow the SEED Chrome extension down to GitHub Issue 135900. The upper path uses SESAME to extract evaluations and then DeepSeek to summarize them. The lower path sends the loaded discussion directly to DeepSeek for a full-text summary.
